gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Neon glows with strokes that never swell or thin, every letter cut from one unbroken line width and spaced generously. Pair it with Noto Sans Lydian at a modest size.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Noto Sans Malayalam fills the middle of each line with generous openings, giving text a friendly, businesslike texture. And Neon, with its marker-thick t and crossbar sharing one width, glows best when the words are few and large.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Glowing tubes meet daylight-open curves. Neon lights up the top with tall, stamped-metal lowercase, while Noto Sans Marchen follows with small letters standing almost capital-sized, so the two feel like a sign above a quiet shop counter.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numer: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals reads tall-bodied and contemporary, with a c that gapes open at any size. But Neon, drawn as if traced with a marker, belongs up big and brief, where its glow can carry a few words.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Neon hums with glyphs that look cut from strips of equal width, spaced loosely and lit up like a sign. Noto Sans Nandinagari does the quieter job, keeping its openings generous and its ascenders short so text stays easy to follow.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Noto Sans Ogham stands tall and looks surprisingly bold, with wide gaps in the e. Over a full page, Neon's glare gives way to a body that feels open, steady and modern.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Neon draws every join as slim as a pipe cleaner, then glows with tall lowercase forms like stamped metal type. Noto Sans Rejang settles beneath it with porthole-wide counters and open gaps in c, e, s and a, giving the glare room to breathe.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic has a big x-height and tight ascender room, with curves that never close back on themselves. Neon, whose round letters have rims matching their stems, would hum above it while Noto Sans Runic keeps a long page moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Neon glows with round bowls that never swell and a stamped-metal lowercase set wide apart. Noto Sans Soyombo sits below with a sizable x-height and open-mouthed curves, handing the sign's glare a sturdy, screen-friendly base.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Curves that leave daylight like a rope's open bight give this body a friendly, clear read. Neon shouts with strokes as stout as drawn pipe cleaner, while Noto Sans Sunuwar quietly handles the sentences with short ascenders on tall lowercase bodies.
